item.title: Steam Awards, Tarn interview + Community creations
item.description: Hey Urists, It’s Alexandra with a community update! It's that time of year again for the Steam Awards and Dwarf Fortress is eligible for the Labor of Love award, for games that have been updated for a long period of time. You can vote using the widget above, we really appreciate it! Tarn Chats with BlindiRL In other community news, Tarn recently sat down with BlindiRL to talk about the latest Myth & Magic news, the audio update and a bunch of other things that happened this year. So if you’re into hearing Tarn talk for long periods of time, this one is for you:New Fortress Story Videos Kruggsmash is back with a new Dwarf Fortress story video featuring stunning illustrations, animation and cozy fall vibes:I also highly recommend checking out VonGalactic’s video on his elaborate dino fort: And if you’d like to watch something A BIT longer, Blind also just released a 5 hour+ video on Battlefailed, the infamous fort story from the Bay 12 forums in 2010:Mod Spotlight: Gorlak Civilization Go...
